dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Hello, friend! What'll you be having today? If you can't decide, just order the Lambad Fish Roll!

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: The tableware in the tavern has just been replaced, too! They're all brand new! That will be sure to cheer you up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I see the menu?

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Sure, here you go. It's all delicious, so have whatever you'd like!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Yesterday I was a sailor, today I'm the owner of this tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: So, you'll be able to taste the chill of the ocean in my tavern's wine. And you won't find fresher seafood anywhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Lambad Fish Roll...

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: It's a recipe I came up with on an adventure in my youth. The flavor of the finished product far exceeded my expectations, so I bestowed it with the great name of "Lambad"!

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: When I was traveling around then, I had delicious grilled fish in Mondstadt, Liyue, and Inazuma. So, it got me thinking that the aroma of grilled fish in the air was just what Sumeru needed, too!

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: And that's how my famous Lambad Fish Roll was born. And it's not just grilled fish — I combined it with Sumeru's specialty pitas to create a fish roll that can be eaten with ease, even on the choppiest of seas.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Such a genius invention is naturally worthy of the resounding name of "Lambad."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Come back any time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You built this tavern overnight? Impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! You're making me blush.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: I was exaggerating when I said that, but I wasn't kidding about being a great sailor in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: I've passed through vast thunderstorms more wrathful than the Raiden Shogun, and I've pierced through glaciers steelier than the Tsaritsa's heart.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: But that was nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: ...Nothing compared to being able to return safely to Sumeru and open this lively tavern! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: New tableware?

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Yep, there was some small accident in the tavern a few days ago, so the original tableware can't be used anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: It turned out to be a blessing in disguise. The tableware we have now is made by craftspeople commissioned by Kshah{RUBY#[S]Technology}rewar researchers, with the patterns designed by Hara{RUBY#[S]Semiotics}vatat researchers.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: There is no other establishment in Sumeru City with such a luxurious setup.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: So you see, little accidents in life aren't necessarily all bad, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this for sampling?

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Of course! The fish was fresh from the water and the pitas just popped out of the oven. Here. Be careful, it's hot!
